mapper.select:
select wp.wo_proc_id, w.wo_id, w.wo_no, w.status as wo_status, w.plant_cd, w.item_id, i.item_cd, i.item_nm, trim_scale(w.plan_qty)::text as plan_qty, w.unit_cd, w.released_at, wp.op_seq, wp.proc_id, wp.proc_cd, wp.proc_nm, wp.status, wp.equip_id, e.equip_cd, e.equip_nm, h.node_cd from prd_wo_proc wp join prd_wo w on w.wo_id = wp.wo_id join mst_item i on i.item_id = w.item_id left join mst_equip e on e.equip_id = wp.equip_id left join mst_equip_hier h on h.node_id = wp.node_id where wp.wo_proc_id = #{id} and w.plant_cd = #{plantCd} and w.status in ('RELEASED', 'IN_PROGRESS')
and (wp.node_id = #{nodeId} or wp.node_id in (select c.node_id from mst_equip_hier c where c.parent_id = #{nodeId}))
for update of wp

select p.wo_param_id, p.param_cd, p.param_nm, p.unit_nm, trim_scale(p.target_val)::text as target_val, trim_scale(p.lsl)::text as lsl, trim_scale(p.usl)::text as usl, a.actual_id as last_actual_id, trim_scale(a.value)::text as last_value, a.judge as last_judge from prd_wo_param p left join lateral ( select x.actual_id, x.value, x.judge from prd_param_actual x where x.wo_param_id = p.wo_param_id and x.reversal_of_id is null and not exists (select 1 from prd_param_actual r where r.reversal_of_id = x.actual_id) order by x.occurred_at desc, x.actual_id desc limit 1) a on true where p.wo_proc_id = #{woProcId} order by p.sort_no, p.param_cd

select i.item_cd, i.item_nm, trim_scale(b.req_qty)::text as req_qty, b.unit_cd from prd_wo_bom b join mst_item i on i.item_id = b.item_id where b.wo_id = #{woId} and b.line_type = 'NORMAL' and (b.op_seq = #{opSeq} or b.op_seq is null) order by b.seq
select defect_id, defect_cd, defect_nm, cat_cd from qms_defect where use_yn = 'Y' order by sort_no, defect_cd
select defect_id from qms_defect where defect_cd = #{defectCd} and use_yn = 'Y'

insert into prd_wo_proc_event (comp_cd, wo_id, wo_proc_id, event_cd, reason_cd, gate_mode, gate_detail, equip_id, terminal_id, work_day, shift_cd, client_req_id, occurred_at, entry_method, recorded_by, performed_by) values (hb_current_comp(), #{f.woId}, #{f.woProcId}, #{f.eventCd}, #{f.reasonCd}, #{f.gateMode}, #{f.gateDetail}, #{f.equipId}, #{f.terminalId}, #{f.workDay}, #{f.shiftCd}, #{f.clientReqId}, #{f.occurredAt}, #{f.entryMethod}, #{by}, #{f.performedBy}) returning event_id
mapper.update: update prd_wo_proc set status = #{to}, row_ver = row_ver + 1, updated_at = now(), updated_by = #{by} where wo_proc_id = #{id} and status = #{from}
update prd_wo set status = 'IN_PROGRESS', row_ver = row_ver + 1, updated_at = now(), updated_by = #{by} where wo_id = #{woId} and status = 'RELEASED'
mapper.select: select event_id, wo_proc_id, event_cd, gate_mode from prd_wo_proc_event where client_req_id = #{req}
select status from prd_wo_proc where wo_proc_id = #{id}

insert into prd_result (comp_cd, wo_id, wo_proc_id, lot_id, equip_id, terminal_id, good_qty, scrap_qty, rework_qty, repair_qty, unit_cd, work_day, shift_cd, client_req_id, reason, occurred_at, entry_method, recorded_by, performed_by, reversal_of_id) values (hb_current_comp(), #{f.woId}, #{f.woProcId}, #{f.lotId}, #{f.equipId}, #{f.terminalId}, #{f.goodQty}, #{f.scrapQty}, #{f.reworkQty}, #{f.repairQty}, #{f.unitCd}, #{f.workDay}, #{f.shiftCd}, #{f.clientReqId}, #{f.reason}, #{f.occurredAt}, #{f.entryMethod}, #{by}, #{f.performedBy}, #{f.reversalOfId}) returning result_id
mapper.insert: insert into prd_result_defect (comp_cd, result_id, kind, defect_id, qty) values (hb_current_comp(), #{resultId}, #{kind}, #{defectId}, #{qty})
mapper.sql: r.result_id, r.wo_id, r.wo_proc_id, r.lot_id, r.equip_id, l.lot_no, trim_scale(r.good_qty)::text as good_qty, trim_scale(r.scrap_qty)::text as scrap_qty, trim_scale(r.rework_qty)::text as rework_qty, trim_scale(r.repair_qty)::text as repair_qty, r.unit_cd, r.work_day, r.shift_cd, r.occurred_at, r.recorded_by, r.performed_by, k.worker_nm, r.reversal_of_id, r.client_req_id, exists (select 1 from prd_result x where x.reversal_of_id = r.result_id) as reversed
from prd_result r left join lot_master l on l.lot_id = r.lot_id left join mst_worker k on k.worker_id = r.performed_by
mapper.select: select where r.result_id = #{id}
select where r.client_req_id = #{req}
select kind, defect_id, trim_scale(qty)::text as qty from prd_result_defect where result_id = #{resultId} order by result_defect_id
select where r.wo_proc_id = #{woProcId} and r.work_day = #{workDay} and r.reversal_of_id is null order by r.occurred_at desc, r.result_id desc limit 50
select trim_scale(plan_qty)::text from prd_wo where wo_id = #{woId}
select count(*) from prd_wo_proc where equip_id = #{equipId} and status in ('RUN', 'PAUSE')

with s as ( select greatest( (select max(e.occurred_at) from prd_wo_proc_event e where e.wo_proc_id = #{woProcId} and e.event_cd = 'START'), (select max(r.occurred_at) from prd_result r where r.wo_proc_id = #{woProcId} and r.reversal_of_id is null and not exists (select 1 from prd_result v where v.reversal_of_id = r.result_id))) as since ) select s.since, trim_scale(coalesce(sum(c.qty) filter (where c.metric_cd = 'GOOD'), 0))::text as good_qty, trim_scale(coalesce(sum(c.qty) filter (where c.metric_cd = 'SCRAP'), 0))::text as scrap_qty from s left join cms_equip_count c on c.equip_id = #{equipId} and c.occurred_at > s.since and c.occurred_at <= #{now} group by s.since
select trim_scale(coalesce(sum(good_qty), 0))::text from prd_result where wo_proc_id = #{woProcId} and work_day = #{workDay}

select d.defect_nm from prd_result_defect x join prd_result r on r.result_id = x.result_id join qms_defect d on d.defect_id = x.defect_id where r.wo_proc_id = #{woProcId} and r.reversal_of_id is null and not exists (select 1 from prd_result v where v.reversal_of_id = r.result_id) order by r.occurred_at desc, r.result_id desc, x.result_defect_id desc limit 1

select g.gen_id from lot_genealogy g join lot_master m on m.lot_id = g.parent_lot_id where g.child_lot_id = #{lotId} and g.wo_proc_id = #{woProcId} and g.rel_type = 'CONSUME' and g.reversal_of_id is null and not exists (select 1 from lot_genealogy v where v.reversal_of_id = g.gen_id) order by m.item_id, g.parent_lot_id, g.gen_id

select distinct g.parent_lot_id from lot_genealogy g where g.child_lot_id = #{lotId} and g.wo_proc_id = #{woProcId} and g.rel_type = 'CONSUME' and g.reversal_of_id is null and not exists (select 1 from lot_genealogy v where v.reversal_of_id = g.gen_id) order by g.parent_lot_id

insert into prd_param_actual (comp_cd, wo_proc_id, wo_param_id, param_cd, value, judge, equip_id, terminal_id, work_day, shift_cd, client_req_id, reason, occurred_at, entry_method, recorded_by, performed_by, reversal_of_id) values (hb_current_comp(), #{f.woProcId}, #{f.woParamId}, #{f.paramCd}, #{f.value}, #{f.judge}, #{f.equipId}, #{f.terminalId}, #{f.workDay}, #{f.shiftCd}, #{f.clientReqId}, #{f.reason}, #{f.occurredAt}, #{f.entryMethod}, #{by}, #{f.performedBy}, #{f.reversalOfId}) returning actual_id
mapper.sql: a.actual_id, a.wo_proc_id, a.wo_param_id, a.param_cd, trim_scale(a.value)::text as value, a.judge, a.reversal_of_id, exists (select 1 from prd_param_actual x where x.reversal_of_id = a.actual_id) as reversed
mapper.select: select from prd_param_actual a where a.actual_id = #{id}
select from prd_param_actual a where a.client_req_id = #{req}
mapper.sql: select e.equip_id, e.equip_cd, e.equip_nm, h.node_cd, e.plant_cd, e.node_id, h.parent_id as parent_node_id, e.use_yn from mst_equip e left join mst_equip_hier h on h.node_id = e.node_id
mapper.select:
where e.plant_cd = #{plantCd} and e.use_yn = 'Y'
and (e.node_id = #{nodeId} or h.parent_id = #{nodeId})
order by e.equip_cd, e.equip_id
where e.equip_id = #{equipId}

insert into pop_approval (comp_cd, terminal_id, requester_worker_id, approver_worker_id, action_cd, target_id, reversal_id, reason, occurred_at, recorded_by) values (hb_current_comp(), #{a.terminalId}, #{a.requesterId}, #{a.approverId}, #{a.action}, #{targetId}, #{reversalId}, #{reason}, #{occurredAt}, #{by}) returning approval_id
